items.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
items.summary: Sweden's Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.

items.title: Mastercard brings stablecoin balances into traditional banking and card payments
items.summary: The launch of Global Money Platform marks Mastercard's first major integration with BVNK since its August acquisition, with Nuvei and Marqeta among the first companies to adopt the platform.

items.title: Bitcoin slips under $80K after US PPI gains most in four years
items.summary: BTC buyers attempted to defend $80,000 support after September US producer inflation overshot expectations by 100 basis points for the largest monthly gain since March 2022

items.title: Russia to ban direct peer-to-peer crypto trades starting July 2027
items.summary: Russia plans to ban direct P2P crypto trades from July 1, 2027, while separate rules already prohibit transfers from digital accounts to self-custody wallets.

items.title: Nasdaq-listed Tron sets up $200M ATM share offering to fuel TRX acquisitions
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed treasury company holds about $237 million in TRX tokens and plans to raise additional capital to fund its purchases, alongside its daily accumulation.

items.title: Can the SEC and CFTC's pro-crypto rules be overturned? Legal opinion
items.summary: The SEC and CFTC have been rolling out pro-crypto rules, but legal experts say they could be overturned by a future administration or by the courts.

items.title: Mastercard and BVNK Launch 'Global Money Platform' to Merge Fiat and Stablecoins
items.summary: The first major integration since Mastercard's $1.8 billion BVNK acquisition lets banks, fintechs and enterprises hold, convert, and spend fiat and stablecoins through a single API, with agentic commerce support planned.

items.title: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion
items.summary: Bitcoin saw sharp moves as nearly $1 billion in crypto positions were liquidated amid macro pressures.

items.title: Ethereum, Altcoins See 'Outsized Drawdowns' Due to Macro Pressures
items.summary: Market analysts say that macro factors are pushing altcoin prices down, after ETH, XRP, and SOL all dropped on the day.

items.title: Ledger Announces Atom Touchscreen Android Device
items.summary: Ledger says the Android-based Atom will carry anti-tamper protections and be sold only on its site, as it probes tampered resold wallets.

items.title: Zcash Tanks Double Digits After 'Meteoric Rise' Sees Leverage Build Up
items.summary: Experts blame a build up in leverage for Zcash's drop in value, as well as growing concerns about AI breaking crypto encryption.

items.title: Morning Minute: Solana Is About To Get Faster
items.summary: Alpenglow is coming next week, slashing Solana finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of about 150 milliseconds-some 85 times faster.

items.title: CleanSpark and BitFuFu see bitcoin production slip in September as Canaan remains flat
items.summary: CleanSpark is ending monthly mining reports, while BitFuFu faces uncertainty over its Ethiopia deal.

items.title: Multiliquid, a settlement platform for tokenized assets, raises $8 million
items.summary: Multiliquid has raised $8 million across its pre-seed and seed rounds, with Polychain leading the seed round.

items.title: Ripple Prime adds RWA swaps referencing perpetual futures listed on Hyperliquid
items.summary: Ripple Prime has added RWA perpetual swaps tied to equities, ETFs, metals, energy and currencies.

items.title: EBA designates Circle's USDC as the EU's first significant e-money token
items.summary: The EBA classified Circle's USDC as the EU's first significant e-money token.

items.title: BNY and Citadel Securities complete first tokenized U.S. Treasury repo on major triparty platform
items.summary: BNY and Citadel Securities completed the first tokenized U.S. Treasury repo workflow on a major triparty platform.

items.title: Strategy's preferred stock financing may cost it bitcoin, K33 argues
items.summary: K33 argues Strategy could accumulate more bitcoin over time by relying on common stock issuance rather than preferred shares.

items.title: Trump's crypto bill loses its White House negotiator as Patrick Witt exits
items.summary: President Donald Trump's crypto agenda has lost a White House negotiator as Patrick Witt confirms his departure and the administration's flagship digital-asset legislation remains stalled in Congress.

items.title: Bitcoin's AI-driven rally faces a hidden danger if the machines get richer but workers don't
items.summary: Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan argued in an Oct. 14 memo that nearly every macroeconomic path ends with Bitcoin higher, including an extraordinary AI productivity boom that makes scarce assets more valuable.

items.title: USDC splits global reserves as EBA enforces Nov 12 handover
items.summary: The EBA's designation brings dual supervision of Circle's EU issuer, while its Oct. 1 response seeks more flexible reserve requirements.

items.title: Qivalis wins Dutch EMI license, but MiCA rules block launch
items.summary: The company says issuance is planned in the coming months, subject to MiCA requirements and white-paper publication.

items.title: Crypto for Advisors: Wall Street is done waiting on Congress for crypto rules
items.summary: Wall Street is moving ahead with crypto products while Congress debates legislation.

items.title: How Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI took down a massive crypto fraud network targeting Russian speakers
items.summary: Prosecutors detailed a large crypto fraud operation that targeted Russian-speaking communities.

items.title: Under pressure, Ledger unveils plan to turn its crypto hardware wallet into a smartphone
items.summary: Ledger is developing an Android-based device combining hardware wallet security with smartphone features.

items.title: Bitcoin, copper, stocks, yields all fall; gold rises
items.summary: Risk assets including Bitcoin declined while gold rose amid inflation concerns.

items.title: Altcoins lead crypto declines as Asian stocks drop; bitcoin little changed since midnight
items.summary: Bitcoin held near $80,000 while altcoins fell with Asian equities.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin bounces after first fall below $80,000 in one month
items.summary: Bitcoin recovered after dipping below $80,000 for the first time in a month.
